verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official, first-party MCP Server that connects meeting transcripts and action items to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools. It is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions and limits the assistant to meetings the user explicitly authorizes. Documented capabilities include searching transcripts across all time periods and analyzing patterns across meetings, and a probe confirms the dedicated blog page. Missing for 10: in-depth reference/setup documentation of the MCP tool surface (sources are marketing and blog level), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
